title: Readings Marked "Bad"
body:
A blood glucose reading can be marked as a "Bad" reading in the Bg Data Table, and that reading will not be used in statistical analyses. This happens routinely for "pressure" lows, initial new sensor readings, and end of sensor on Dexcom.

It would be visually very valuable to have the dots making up the main graph to have a different user defined color for readings marked "Bad" in the Bg Data Table.

This could be implemented in the xDrip+ Color Settings.

![Screenshot_20210524-220126_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15315426/119433426-d86fd700-bcdb-11eb-983b-2cbd361cccd0.jpg)

This screenshot shows that at about 5am I had a pressure low. (Finger stick read 89.) It would be valuable to make those five or so bad readings a different color.
